and others }} '''Clerics''' are characters in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== {{main|Clerics}} These clerics are the religious leaders of the [[Brotherhood of Steel]] chapter known as the [[Knights of San Fernando]]. Aside from various unnamed clerics, they include [[Quintus|Elder Cleric Quintus]] and [[Felix (TV series)|Cleric Felix]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== Cleric [[Felix (TV series)|Felix]] and another cleric are shown teaching the [[Aspirant (TV series)|aspirants]] their duties for when they finally become [[Squire (TV series)|squires]]. A cleric oversees a [[Scribe (TV series)|scribe]] copy down the picture of a target. The next day, Elder Cleric Quintus interrogates aspirant [[Maximus]] for injuring the newly promoted squire [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]]. After, he exonerates him and anoints him as squire to [[Titus|Knight Titus]]. Eventually, an anointment ceremony is held, which is conducted by Felix, with Quintus and another cleric also in attendance. Soon afterward, Elder Cleric Quintus gives a speech about a [[Siggi Wilzig|denizen]] of the [[Enclave]] who has escaped with a [[Cold fusion|dangerous device]]. Standing beside him was Cleric Felix and the other unnamed cleric. ===[[The Beginning]]=== At the Brotherhood usurped [[Filly]], Elder Cleric Quintus with some clerics close by to him. He forces Maximus to confess that the head he has is a fake one. This, in turn, forces Dane to confess that they lied about who injured them. Later, Elder Cleric Quintus has a private talk with Maximus, and learning of Titus' cowardice, forces him to fight in the front lines of the raid at [[Griffith Observatory]]. ===[[The Golden Rule]]=== Clerics are first seen aboard the ''[[Caswennan]]'' when Maximus returns with the key to [[Area 51]]. Several clerics are later seen as part of the initial exploration group studying the artifacts in the primary Area 51 warehouse. Later, four clerics are seen during Quintus' meeting with the elders of the [[Coronado Brotherhood of Steel|Coronado]], [[Grand Canyon Brotherhood of Steel|Grand Canyon]], and [[Yosemite Brotherhood of Steel|Yosemite chapters]], as well as the gladiatorial brawls following the meeting. ===[[The Profligate]]=== Six clerics are in attendance during Elder Cleric Quintus' final meeting with the Yosemite elder, during which the Yosemite elder retracts her support for Quintus' rebellion and departs. When Maximus offers to resolve the situation by killing [[Xander Harkness|Paladin Xander Harkness]], the clerics look at him in bewilderment and disapproval. Soon after, two clerics are seen walking around outside Area 51 when Maximus encounters Paladin Harkness, and a third cleric is talking to an aspirant near a suit of power armor. Harkness claims that the clerics "won't even look at [him]" and points out that the Knights of San Fernando have a particularly large amount of clerics compared to the Commonwealth chapter, insulting the clerics by comparing them to cockroaches. ===[[The Strip]]=== Past the end credits, when the scene goes back to the [[Area 51]] base, two clerics are seen, one (played by [[Robert Lee Bell]]) patching up [[Riley (TV series)|Knight Riley]], the other opening the door for [[Dane (TV series)|Dane]]. ==Appearances== The unnamed clerics appear only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|1=101|8=108|10=202|11=203|16=208}} ==Behind the scenes== One of the unnamed clerics in "[[The Beginning]]" is played by actor [[Collin Ware]] (credited as "chanting cleric"), and the cleric at the door into Quintus' office in "[[The Strip]]" is played by [[Antony Sauvé]].
